page.layout: One page of a bound book, with no printed text. Handwritten ink annotations lie across the leaf, and a strip of the facing page with handwriting is visible at the right edge. No printed blocks.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The visible writing is manuscript annotation and is not transcribed: a line near the top reading roughly "argumentum contra ..." with "Orem" beneath it, a few marks and flourishes, a vertical handwritten name ("Enyard" or similar) with a line beside it, and a page number at the top right of the facing strip. Ink blots and stains cover the upper and middle of the leaf. The page is handwritten and stained, with no printed headings, running heads or page numbers.
